title: Step data for an offline net2: net2's 600 training links, every step kept
description: Data for training expliCCit's memoryless actor offline (expliccit train run) on a net1 with one value per LCF: the 600 links of examples/net1_broad.py's set net2-train (links no net1 was trained on), two conditions each from the broad set of 64, three controllers per link (the 17 stock ones, the four delay-threshold policies and release model-net1v3's fixed rule, alone and with exploration), 30 s episodes, with every step kept, since net2 learns from consecutive steps.
prepare: for s in net2-train; do uv run python examples/net1_broad.py "$OUT/spec-$s" --set $s --models "$IN/models"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$s/campaign.json" "$OUT/campaign-$s"; done
run: for s in net2-train; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/campaign-$s" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: echo '| set | status |' > "$OUT/summary.md"; echo '|---|---|' >> "$OUT/summary.md"; for s in net2-train; do uv run expliccit campaign status "$OUT/campaign-$s" > "$OUT/status-$s.json"; echo "| $s | $(jq -c . "$OUT/status-$s.json") |" >> "$OUT/summary.md"; done
